k_env.note: Ambient heat infiltration conductance per building thermal mass.

k_int.note: Internal heat gain coefficient. Low telemetry excitation during unoccupied hours.

k_ac.note: Direct HVAC cooling temperature reduction rate.

h_env.note: Moisture infiltration rate influenced by building envelope leaks.

h_T.note: Linear psychrometric approximation of Clausius-Clapeyron curve around 25°C, not a universal constant.

k_win.note: No window state telemetry in CU-BEMS dataset. Assumed based on ASHRAE natural ventilation literature.

h_win.note: No window state telemetry in CU-BEMS dataset. Assumed based on ASHRAE natural ventilation literature.
